outcome: Low Apgar scores at five minutes
cohort: 7,103 nulliparous women with a singleton full-term foetus in a cephalic presentation and spontaneous onset of labour, participating in The Labour Progression Study (LaPS) in Norway between 2014 and 2017
finding: Nulliparous women receiving one-to-one midwifery care in the active phase of labour were less likely to use epidural analgesia or nitrous oxide, more likely to receive massages, and less likely to have a caesarean section or operative vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Women receiving one-to-one midwifery care in the active phase of labour were less likely to have a caesarean section (5.8% vs. 7.2%) and they are less likely to have an operative vaginal birth (16.5% vs. 23.7%).
